title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 01
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stopping' in ventilation is used to
options: Seal off areas from ventilation system
questions.solution: Stoppings seal off areas from the ventilation system.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'references' in a report should include
options: Relevant regulations, standards, and previous reports if applicable
questions.solution: Relevant regulations, standards, and previous reports.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'status report' for a section should include
options: Progress of work, safety status, and any problems encountered
Only the number of persons employed
questions.solution: Progress of work, safety status, and problems encountered.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety leadership' in a mine starts from
options: The top management including the manager
questions.solution: Safety leadership starts from top management including the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'pressure relief valve' in a water dam is used to
options: Measure water depth behind the dam
Control the release of impounded water at safe rates
questions.solution: Controls release of impounded water at safe rates.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'conclusion' of a report should
options: Summarize findings and link to recommendations
questions.solution: Summarize findings and link to recommendations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The primary purpose of stowing is to
options: Control subsidence and support the roof
questions.solution: Control subsidence and support the roof.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'surface rescue team' vs 'underground rescue team' - the underground team is
options: Not required to wear breathing apparatus
Trained specifically for underground mine rescue conditions
questions.solution: Trained specifically for underground mine rescue conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'detail survey' in mining maps
options: Only the outline of the mine boundary
Levels of the main haulage road only
Detailed features of mine workings and surface
questions.solution: Detail surveys map detailed features of workings and surface.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'provisions for rescue and relief' in mines are specified under
options: Mines Act 1952 and Mines Rescue Rules 1985
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952 and Mines Rescue Rules 1985.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stemming material used in shot firing is
questions.solution: Clay or water stemming is used to confine explosive energy.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In 'shortwall mining', the face length is typically
questions.solution: Less than 100 meters.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'probable reserve' of coal is
options: Indicated by exploration but not fully confirmed
questions.solution: Probable reserves are indicated but not fully confirmed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sublevel caving' method involves
options: Extracting coal in ascending order from the floor
Allowing the roof to cave after extracting coal from sublevels
Removing coal in horizontal slices from the surface
questions.solution: Roof caves after extraction from sublevels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Carbon monoxide (CO) in mines is produced by
options: Incomplete combustion of explosives, fires, and machinery exhaust
questions.solution: Incomplete combustion of explosives, fires, and machinery exhaust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The fire drill in a mine must be conducted
options: At regular intervals as prescribed by the manager
questions.solution: At regular intervals as prescribed by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pumping capacity' in a mine must be
options: At least 50% more than the maximum expected water inflow
Just sufficient for normal working days
Equal to the daily rainfall on the surface
questions.solution: At least 50% more than maximum expected water inflow.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'caking property' of coal refers to
options: Ability to form coherent mass when heated
questions.solution: Caking property is ability to form coherent mass when heated.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a sirdar is required to be posted at a station designated by which person?
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: the manager fixes the STATION posts and the sirdar is posted there during his shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'longwall retreat' method typically has pillars that are
options: Extracted after the panel is sealed
questions.solution: Extracted as face retreats.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Detonating cord in coal mines is used to
options: Detonate charges by friction or impact
questions.solution: Detonating cord transmits the detonation wave at high velocity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A water spray system is used in mines to
options: Suppress coal dust at the source
questions.solution: Water spray suppresses coal dust at the source.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'leakage' in mine ventilation occurs when
options: Fresh air enters the workings from surface cracks
Air escapes through stoppings, doors, and other openings
Air becomes heated in deep workings
There is always zero leakage in a well-designed mine
questions.solution: Ventilation leakage occurs through stoppings, doors, and openings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, the sirdar is a
questions.solution: The sirdar is a competent person under the Mines Act 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main advantage of longwall mining is
options: High extraction ratio and continuous production
questions.solution: High extraction ratio and continuous production.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'block caving' method is suitable for
options: Thick seams with weak overlying rock
questions.solution: Thick seams with weak overlying rock.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal seam pinching out' means
options: Coal seam gradually thins and disappears
questions.solution: Pinching out is when seam thins and disappears.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast timing' accuracy with electronic detonators is
questions.solution: Electronic detonators provide timing accuracy of ±1 ms or better.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'standing support' in mining includes
options: Props, chocks, cribs, and other load-bearing elements
questions.solution: Standing support includes props, chocks, and cribs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'power loading' in mining refers to
options: Loading of explosives into shot holes
Mechanized loading of coal at the face
Transporting coal by rail on the surface
questions.solution: Mechanized loading of coal at the face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system in a shaft must have
options: Overwinding prevention device and safety catches
questions.solution: Overwinding prevention device and safety catches are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The power to grant a certificate of competency to a sirdar lies with
options: The DGMS or a Board of Examiners
questions.solution: The DGMS or a Board of Examiners grants the certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The accident prevention measures include
options: Training, PPE, safe systems, inspections, and safety culture
questions.solution: Training, PPE, safe systems, inspections, and safety culture.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: While examining opencast workings, the sirdar must check the highwall and bench edges for:
options: Overhangs and any obstruction, staying at least 3 m away from the edge
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129 (opencast duties): the sirdar examines highwall/bench edges for overhangs and loose material, keeping at least 3 m from the edge.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum number of persons permitted in a man riding car depends on
options: The design capacity and safe working load
questions.solution: Capacity depends on design and safe working load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Operator fatigue management includes
options: Allowing operators to work double shifts
Regular breaks, shift rotation, fatigue detection
questions.solution: Fatigue management uses breaks, rotation, and monitoring.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'longitudinal section' shows
options: Plan view of the mine surface
Horizontal section at seam floor level
Vertical view along the length of workings
questions.solution: Longitudinal sections show vertical views along workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: During examination in a fiery seam, the sirdar is required to carry:
options: An approved flame safety lamp and a carbon monoxide detector
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: where there is danger of fire or accumulation of gas, the sirdar carries an approved flame safety lamp and a carbon monoxide detector.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, when must a sirdar carry out the first examination of a place before work is commenced in it?
options: At the exact time of commencement of work
At least 2 hours before commencement of work
Within 2 hours before commencement of work
At least 1 hour before commencement of work
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: the first examination shall be carried out within 2 hours before the commencement of work in the place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'yield load' of a hydraulic prop is
options: The load at which the prop yields to prevent failure
questions.solution: Yield load is where the prop yields to prevent structural failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must check the correct functioning of
options: Safety devices, supports, and ventilation in his area
The blasting operations in other districts
questions.solution: Safety devices, supports, and ventilation must all be checked.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'full column grouted' roof bolt is anchored by
options: Grout along the full length of the bolt
Anchor only at the collar of the hole
questions.solution: Full column bolts are grouted along their entire length.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The report of a sirdar's examination under CMR 2017 shall be recorded in:
options: A bound paged book in the prescribed format
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: results are recorded in a bound paged book kept for the purpose, in the prescribed format, signed and dated.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue team role assignment' includes
options: Team leader, gas detector, stretcher bearer, first aider
questions.solution: Roles include leader, detector, bearer, first aider.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Retreat mining in board and pillar involves
options: Extraction in ascending order from the top
Extracting pillars while retreating towards main entries
questions.solution: Retreat mining extracts pillars while moving back towards main entries.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face profile' after blasting indicates
options: Effectiveness of the blast in breaking rock face
The grade of the coal seam
Strength of the explosives used only
questions.solution: Face profiles indicate blast effectiveness.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'support failure report' should include
options: Location, type of support failed, likely cause, and immediate action taken
questions.solution: Location, type, cause, and immediate action.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'Chief Inspector' has the power to
options: Cancel or suspend certificates of competency
Appoint the manager of the mine
questions.solution: Cancel or suspend certificates of competency.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'permit to work' system is used to
options: Control high-risk activities through formal authorization
questions.solution: Controls high-risk activities through formal authorization.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A good report should be
questions.solution: Clear, concise, accurate, and factual.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'underhand stoping' method involves working
options: In vertical slices from the surface
questions.solution: Working downward from a horizontal back.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal is formed from
options: Remains of ancient vegetation subjected to heat and pressure
questions.solution: Coal forms from vegetation remains subjected to geological processes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The roof bolting machine is used to
options: Install roof bolts for immediate roof support
questions.solution: Installs roof bolts for immediate roof support.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'format' of the sirdar's report book entries should be
options: Any format convenient to the sirdar
questions.solution: As prescribed by the regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017, how often must a sirdar re-examine a place during a shift where work is going on?
options: Once at the middle of the shift only
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: every such place shall be re-examined at least once in every 4 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A cable drum in a mine must be stored
options: In any open area exposed to rain
On a proper drum stand, protected from moisture and damage
questions.solution: On a proper drum stand, protected from moisture and damage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding rope must be replaced if
options: Its diameter has reduced by more than the prescribed limit
questions.solution: Replacement is required if diameter reduction exceeds prescribed limit.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The man riding vehicle must not exceed its
options: No fixed limit if the vehicle is new
Payload limit fixed by the driver
questions.solution: Must not exceed designed seating capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'retreating longwall' method involves
options: Extracting coal from the boundary towards the shaft
Extracting coal from the shaft towards the boundary
Leaving a central pillar in the panel
questions.solution: Extracting coal from boundary towards shaft.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'residual value' of mine is
options: Estimated value of remaining extractable minerals
questions.solution: Residual value is estimated worth of remaining minerals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'witness statement' in an accident report should be
options: Recorded as given by the witness without alteration
questions.solution: Recorded as given by the witness without alteration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'break line' in depillaring indicates
options: The line where roof is expected to fall
questions.solution: Break line indicates where roof is expected to cave in as pillars are extracted.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'return air' in mine ventilation is
questions.solution: Return air is contaminated air leaving the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'spraying' at coal face is done to
options: Suppress dust and prevent gas accumulation
questions.solution: Spraying suppresses dust and prevents gas accumulation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'misfire' in blasting refers to
options: A shot that produces excessive fumes
A shot fired at the wrong time
A shot that fails to explode
questions.solution: A shot that fails to explode.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'hand drilling' method for drifting uses
questions.solution: Pneumatic jackhammers or hand-operated drills.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'medical examination' of mine workers is required under
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952 and CMR 2017.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'line of goaf' or 'goaf edge' is maintained at
options: A safe distance behind the working face
questions.solution: Safe distance behind working face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire extinguisher' requirement for heavy equipment is
questions.solution: Fire extinguishers are mandatory for all mobile equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Hydraulic stowing uses
options: Water as a transport medium for stowing material
questions.solution: Hydraulic stowing uses water to transport material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety devices of a man riding system must be tested
questions.solution: Testing before each shift is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'rescue officer' in a mine must be
options: A person holding a first-aid certificate only
A person with a first-aid certificate
A trained and competent person designated by the manager
questions.solution: A trained and competent person designated by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cushion shot' in coal mines is used when
options: There is risk of damage to roof or floor
questions.solution: Cushion shots minimize damage to roof and floor by reducing shock wave.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'shootfirer' in coal mines must hold a valid
questions.solution: Shotfirers must hold valid certificates as per CMR 2017.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An FLP enclosure stands for
questions.solution: FLP stands for Flameproof Enclosure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'subsidence survey' monitors
options: Surface movement and deformation due to mining
questions.solution: Subsidence surveys monitor surface movement due to mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The number of trained first aiders required depends on
options: The number of persons employed as prescribed
questions.solution: Depends on the number of persons employed as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A winding engine used for winding persons must be examined by a competent person
options: At intervals prescribed by the regulations
questions.solution: At intervals prescribed by the regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Winding persons in a shaft used for material must be
options: Permitted only with the manager's approval and safety measures
questions.solution: Permitted only with manager's approval and safety measures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The distance at which advance bore-holes must be maintained ahead of the working when approaching water-logged workings is
questions.solution: CMR 2017 (Chapter XI): advance bore-holes shall be constantly maintained at not less than 3 m ahead of the working when approaching disused or water-logged workings; flank bore-holes at intervals of not more than 5 m.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: What comes next: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.solution: E+V: first letter advances, last letter retreats.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'underground coal mining' technology improvements include
options: Continuous miners, longwall, and bolter miners
questions.solution: Continuous miners, longwall, and bolter miners.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Grade A' coal in India has the
questions.solution: Grade A coal has the highest calorific value.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India's 'Gaganyaan' mission aims to
questions.solution: Send Indian astronauts to space.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Pokhran-II' nuclear tests were conducted in
questions.solution: Pokhran-II tests were in 1998.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL's digital initiatives' include
options: Online e-auction, digital monitoring, and GPS tracking
questions.solution: Online e-auction, digital monitoring, and GPS tracking.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which is the largest organ of the human body?
questions.solution: Skin is the largest organ.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coking coal' is primarily used for
questions.solution: Coking coal is used for steel making.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The famous Red Fort is located in
questions.solution: Red Fort is in Delhi.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'opencast to underground coal production' ratio in India is approximately
questions.solution: Approximately 90:10.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The first Prime Minister of India was
questions.solution: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first PM.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India's first nuclear test was conducted at
questions.solution: First nuclear test was at Pokhran in 1974.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Diagonal of square with side 7cm?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Aryabhata' satellite was launched in
questions.solution: Aryabhata was launched in 1975.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A pipe fills a tank in 15 hours. Another fills in 20 hours. Together in?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: What comes next in the pattern: J, F, M, A, M, J, J, ?
questions.solution: First letters of months: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal sector digitization' helps in
questions.solution: Improved monitoring, efficiency, and decisions.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A bar chart: Sales = 100, 150, 200, 250. What is the trend?
questions.solution: Sales are increasing.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal quality parameters' important for end users include
options: Depth and thickness of the seam
Calorific value, ash content, moisture, and sulphur content
questions.solution: Calorific value, ash, moisture, and sulphur.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal bed methane' (CBM) blocks in India have been auctioned by
options: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
questions.solution: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
